name: hand-limit-15
description: THE HAND LIMIT AT 15 (02/09/2026, RE-POINTED 03/09/2026). ⚠️ WRITTEN AGAINST A SHIPPED 12; the shipped limit is 7, so this is now the far loose end of the ladder rather than one rung above. The looser arm of the pair. It is the more interesting of the two, because it asks the question the reinstatement itself dodged: how much of the v31 no-limit disaster was the ABSENCE of a ceiling and how much was the ceiling being LOW? At 15 the rule is barely a design constraint - it is close to a pure safety rail on the legal-move enumerator - so if this arm plays the same as the shipped 12 on the bonus mix and the hook, then 12 is doing nothing a rail could not do and the honest thing is to say so rather than to keep a number that reads as tuned. If instead the visit share falls and the free Draw 1 rises at 15, that is the diminishing-return story confirmed and 12 is a real design value. READ: the bonus mix four ways with the visit counted separately from the self-visit; the median and maximum hand; the discard rate; and the WORST LEGAL-MOVE COUNT, which is the number the whole rule exists to bound - C(14,4) is 1001 payments for one buildable card against C(11,4)'s 330, so 15 is roughly three times the worst-case branching of 12 and a run at this value will be slower for that reason alone. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
